description: STEP 4 §6 (docs/audit/TEAMMATE_RULE_DATA_INTEGRATION_REPORT.md). Single alias registry for factor-name variants observed across data/rules/regional_rules.json, individual_rules.json, data/rules/central_max_adjustment_range.json, docs/incoming_rule_sources/*.doc, and data/sources/competition/評價基準明細表範例.pdf's own note-sentence text (Phase 3A/3C). NOT a second factor-naming system -- canonical_factor_id/canonical_name always equal an ALREADY-EXISTING factor string from one of these official/digitized sources (never invented). `confidence` and `verified_by` are honest: every entry here was derived by systematic exact-match cross-referencing during this round's audit, not by a human domain-expert sign-off -- `verified_by` stays null until a human explicitly confirms an entry (see this file's own README note below); do not treat presence in this file as VERIFIED.
verification_note: None of the entries below have verified_by set -- this round (STEP 4) only PROPOSES aliases from deterministic cross-referencing (exact string match after normalizing whitespace/punctuation-width/a known character variant, or exact substring containment in an official note sentence). A human reviewer should set verified_by=<name> (and may raise/lower confidence) on any entry before treating it as authoritative for automated factor-mapping decisions beyond Phase 3A's existing exact-match-only policy.
